subject: Elementary Dyslexia Screening Pilot Programs
overview: The committee approved a $1.34 million custodial services contract and reviewed the implementation of new literacy and dyslexia screening tools for elementary students. They also addressed community concerns regarding bus safety and overcrowding and accepted grants for vocational and environmental programs.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Bills
items.summary: Approved the minutes from October 7, 2019, and routine payroll and bills following inquiries into maintenance costs for landscaping and pool chemicals.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent highlighted student scholarships for Italian heritage, a $10,000 Verizon grant for a high school makerspace, and upcoming college information sessions.

items.title: Community Participation on Bus Safety
items.summary: Cheryl Rodriguez raised safety and overcrowding concerns regarding middle school bus #2, including incidents where students were dropped off at incorrect locations and forced to walk home.

items.title: Blanding’s Turtle Grant
items.summary: Accepted a $2,205.72 grant from the Morton and Spopari Family Foundation to support the high school's Blanding's turtle headstarting conservation program.

items.title: Vocational School Fundraising Initiatives
items.summary: Authorized a spring 2020 fundraising dinner at the Bistro and established a new revolving account for vocational school fundraising proceeds.

items.title: Personnel and Hiring Report
items.summary: Reviewed district staffing updates, including the resignation of the nutritionist and the certification status of teachers filling long-term vacancies.

items.title: Dyslexia Screening Pilot Programs
items.summary: Reviewed the implementation of MAP and Lexia Rapid literacy screening tools and approved a motion to send standardized notification letters to parents regarding test results.

items.title: Custodial Services Contract Award
items.summary: Approved a three-year, $1.34 million cleaning contract with Compass Facility Services and directed a future cost-benefit analysis of returning custodial work to in-house staff.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Convened to discuss food service negotiations and collective bargaining updates for the Top and First unions.
